freshnessContract.generatedAt: actual completion time of the current Stock News publication check
freshnessContract.verifiedContentUpdatedAt: time the verified story set last changed
freshnessContract.lastCheckedAt: source-search time after authoritative 15-symbol Stock collection
freshnessContract.coverageFreshness: per-symbol fresh review plus at least one genuinely current substantive event or market read-through
freshnessContract.reviewRule: a fresh review cannot make stale substantive content current
freshnessContract.schemaRule: freshness metadata does not add or fabricate event timestamps on public stories
